shared_elements: curvilinear low-relief carving of abstract forms
justification: Both surfaces carry a prominent circular disc/ring motif carved in low relief within a bilaterally symmetrical schematic composition, and both use curvilinear crescent-like elements around that centre. But A is a self-contained radial rosette-like disc with a toothed rim and repeated perforated lozenges organised concentrically, while B is a vertical humanoid/anthropomorphic form whose back bears stacked, distinct motifs (paired curved shapes above a ring, with a belt-like band and vertical elements below) — the overall subject and layout are quite different.
